description: Team Aero SpaceX (Hyderabad) is tackling the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge (Be An Earth System Trend Detective!). We blend frontend development and data analysis to build intuitive tools that decode critical climate indicators. We are seeking collaborative teammates skilled in Data Analysis, Web Development, and AI/ML to join our crew. Let's build something out of this world!
summary:
roject Overview
Project Name: spaceX28

Target Audience: Designed for students and young creators looking for a streamlined space to explore ideas, learn new skills, and track progress at their own pace.

Core Value Proposition: A clean, distraction-free environment that simplifies learning and skill-building with intuitive navigation and hands-on elements.

Key Features & Architecture
Landing Page & Hero Section: Features a dark, space-themed aesthetic backed by a starfield effect, highlighting the core mission statement ("Aim higher. Start your mission today") with calls to action for early access and the interactive simulator.

Feature Highlights & Workflow: Breaks down the platform's advantages into clear sections detailing how visitors can join, choose their learning path, and track their ongoing progress.

Interactive Launch Simulator: An embedded simulation tool that lets users adjust parameters like fuel, thrust, and gravity to launch a virtual rocket and monitor real-time altitude metrics.

Early Access Sign-Up: A secure database-connected form allowing visitors to register their email addresses for launch notifications, complete with duplicate handling and confirmation messages.

Secure Admin Dashboard: A password-protected administrative interface backed by authentication, enabling project owners to view, manage, and export early-access sign-up data.
